root_cause: search-service's in-memory index cache grows without eviction until the container reaches about 98% of its 1Gi limit. Constant garbage collection then stalls requests, which shows up as high latency before any OOM kill.
contributing_factors: No recent deployment or traffic change

remediation.recommendation: Bound the index cache and raise the memory limit
steps: Add eviction to the index cache
Raise memory limit to 2Gi as a stop-gap
Alert on memory above 85% of limit
